method: One automatically generated proposition list per treatment replicate; pass complete compact JSON without human editing to an otherwise identical A2 request plus frozen generic suffix. No gold, no case-specific hints. Raw source retained. Extract 2500 output tokens; compose/baseline 900; explanation 2-4 sentences unchanged. Extra call, tokens and generic guidance are a bundled intervention, not an isolated structural-format effect.
runtime: Fixed hash order of 12 pipeline slots; treatment extraction immediately precedes composition; sequential requests. Freeze recipe before generation, bind actual dynamic request to exact extraction response. Stop on delivery/schema/transport/usage/model/size/budget error; preserve all slots, no rerun. Quote matching is diagnostic only, never semantic grading or response selection.
evaluation: Same nine requirements and completeness/ambiguity rules; primary surface explanation only. Coordinator manual review first, sealed before intermediate-stage inspection. No independent or two-reviewer success claim in this bounded run. Further independent review remains required before advancement.
diagnosis: After final review, manually score extraction fields (quotes alone do not count) against same requirements; classify extraction omission, lost in composition, recovery, preserved or unresolved. This localizes observed losses, not internal causal mechanisms.
decision: No automatic unseen-clause promotion. Report fresh A2 vs P1 counts, unresolved bounds, paired regressions, distortion and stage-localized omissions. Improvement candidate only if P1 confirmed completeness exceeds A2 upper bound with no paired complete regression and no distortion-upper-bound increase; single-review evidence never replaces prior two-review gate.
limitations: 3 previously observed development sources, not 6 independent sources; no p-values/CI/generalization; no post-output tuning or selection.
